name: HttpResponse
lead: What `http.get` returns. A failed request is not an error: read `ok`.

functions.name: json
functions.description: The body as a table; an error when it is not JSON.

functions.name: image
functions.signature: httpResponse:image() → {width: number, height: number, pixels: buffer}
functions.description: A PNG body: `pixels` is 4 bytes (RGBA) a pixel, row by row from the top.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The HTTP status; 0 when no answer came.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Why no answer came, or nil.

fields.name: headers
fields.description: The answer's headers, names in lower case.
